UserCompany.title: UserCompany
UserCompany.description: Company profile metadata and operational facilities boundary belonging to the authenticated user

userId.description: The UID of the authenticated user who owns this company profile

name.description: Official registered business or entity name

industrySector.description: Economic or NACE industry activity sector

employeeCount.description: Total count of active personnel or employees

reportingYear.description: GHG protocol / CSRD E1 reporting fiscal year

facilities.description: Array of controlled operational sites, offices, warehouses, or vehicle fleets

Activity.title: Activity
Activity.description: A single Scope 1 or Scope 2 greenhouse gas emissions ledger log entry

id.description: Unique identifier of the activity record

userId.description: The UID of the user who owns this activity entry

date.description: Calendar date of consumption in YYYY-MM-DD format

facilityId.description: Identifier of the controlled physical facility where emission occurred

subType.description: Specific fuel or energy carrier type

value.description: Quantitative consumption amount in kWh or litres

emissions.description: Calculated total greenhouse gas emissions in kg CO2e

description.description: Optional notes or invoice supplier details

isExtracted.description: Flag indicating if extracted automatically by Gemini multimodal bill scan

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp when the entry was created

/users/{userId}.description: User company profile and organizational facilities

/users/{userId}/activities/{activityId}.description: Individual Scope 1 and Scope 2 carbon activity records belonging to the user
